headline: Sensex and Nifty rally led by auto and bank stocks while global AI fears weigh on Asian markets

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Indian markets bounced back strongly led by auto and banking sector gains.
FPIs poured Rs 1 lakh crore into Indian stocks, supporting market sentiment.
Asian equities faced selloffs as AI fears impacted regional sentiment despite Anthropic's IPO pop.
Oil prices remained elevated above $92 per barrel even as Hormuz oil flows hit record levels.
whatHappening: Sensex surged nearly 1,000 points while Nifty reclaimed the 25,500 mark.
Foreign Institutional Investors (FPIs) invested Rs 1 lakh crore into Indian equities.
Anthropic debuted on Nasdaq with shares surging 34% to hit a $2 trillion valuation.
Asian benchmarks including Nikkei and Kospi dropped up to 4% amid global market jitters.
summary: Indian share markets staged a major rally as Nifty surpassed 25,500 and Sensex surged nearly 1,000 points, propelled by banking and auto stocks. FPI inflows reached Rs 1 lakh crore, providing sustained support to Indian equities. In contrast, global and Asian markets experienced sharp selloffs due to AI trade concerns.
